task:
`load()` in `src/appconf/loader.py` merges configuration from three sources
but applies them in the wrong order, and it ignores environment variables
that use the `APP_` prefix.

Required precedence, highest first: environment variables, file values,
defaults. An environment variable `APP_<KEY>` (upper case) sets `<key>`
(lower case). Environment variables without the `APP_` prefix are ignored.
Values from the environment are strings; convert "true"/"false"
(case-insensitive) to booleans and purely numeric strings to int. Keys
present in no source must not appear in the result.
